decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to create a powerful and versatile toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played using Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The deck focuses on combo potential, utilizing cards like Blood Artist and Geralf's Messenger to drain the opponent's life and gain advantage. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician serves as both a combo piece and a card draw engine. The deck also includes a strong mana base, allowing for smooth and efficient gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the right creatures at the right time to outvalue and overwhelm the opponent.

The deck revolves around utilizing a combination of cards to quickly assemble a powerful engine or game-winning combo. It focuses on using cards like Underworld Breach, Wishclaw Talisman, and Lotus Field to generate lots of mana and draw through the deck rapidly. By combining spells with alternative costs and card draw effects, the deck aims to set up a game-winning sequence that overwhelms the opponent in a short amount of time. The deck's versatility allows for different win conditions and strategies based on the situation.

The deck focuses on using low-cost, versatile spells and creatures to apply pressure on the opponent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. It aims to control the board and maintain card advantage through card draw effects like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The deck's win condition is to quickly build up a large board presence with evasive threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler, overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to maintain control through disruption and versatile spells while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, maintaining card advantage with cards like Archmage's Charm and Expressive Iteration. Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder help to filter draws and disrupt the opponent's plans. The mana base includes fetch lands for consistency and shock lands for flexibility, allowing the deck to leverage its powerful spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of spells and abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage through powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, while also having a strong late-game with the ability to cast powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and dictate the pace of play until it can establish a dominant board presence.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly to play powerful land-based combo pieces, such as Primeval Titan and Urza's Saga, to generate a large amount of mana for explosive plays. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Amulet of Vigor and Arboreal Grazer to quickly get multiple lands onto the battlefield, allowing for massive combos and powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By efficiently searching for key lands and utilizing synergies between creatures and lands, the deck aims to quickly assemble its win conditions and overpower the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent's life total using efficient and low-cost red spells and creatures. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total before they can stabilize or set up their own game plan. It includes a mix of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm, along with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide to apply consistent pressure. The deck also includes burn spells like Lava Spike and Searing Blaze to finish off the opponent.

This deck relies on a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using tutoring spells like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. By sacrificing creatures with abilities like persist, undying, and enter the battlefield triggers, the deck can create a combo loop to drain the opponent's life with Blood Artist. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician acts as both a combo piece and a source of card advantage. The deck seeks to value creatures that provide utility on the battlefield and can be sacrificed for additional benefits.

This deck focuses on using a wide variety of spells and abilities to control the game and out-value the opponent. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also generating value through cards like Wrenn and Six and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes powerful one-ofs like Emrakul, the Promised End and Endurance to provide additional versatility and win conditions. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the diverse range of spells and abilities in the deck.

This deck aims to utilize Death's Shadow as a powerful threat that grows in size based on the player's life total. By combining aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure on the opponent. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provides additional value by disrupting the opponent's hand and graveyard. With efficient removal and card selection spells, the deck looks to outpace and overwhelm the opponent in a fast-paced game.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of attaching Colossus Hammer to a creature equipped with Sigarda's Aid, allowing for a quick and powerful attack. By utilizing Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip key pieces, along with support from Giver of Runes for protection and Kor Outfitter for additional speed, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a lethal combination of equipment and creatures. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional tutor options, while the land base allows for consistent mana production and access to colorless mana sources.

The deck revolves around efficiently equipping creatures with powerful equipment, specifically Colossus Hammer, to set up quick and deadly combos. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to fetch and equip the necessary pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large, evasive threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Esper Sentinel and Shadowspear to control the opponent's board while going for the kill. With the help of Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and strike before the opponent has a chance to react.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption, with an emphasis on countering opponents' spells and dealing direct damage. It includes cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat for removal, as well as Counterspell and Spell Pierce for control. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides fast and efficient creature pressure, while Murktide Regent offers a powerful late-game threat. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain tempo and consistency. The mana base is designed to support the deck's low curve and spell-heavy strategy.
